content:
Best Buy has updated its massive 60th anniversary sale event, adding a new round of discounts. We continue tracking multiple great deals, including AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off, AirPods Max 2 down $120, and AirTag 2 hitting an all-time low price. Today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break, however, is highlighting a massive $500 price drop on the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro via Amazon, Anker's newly launched SmartTrack Find My wallet card dropping to a new all-time low of $25, and Mint Mobile's unlimited talk, text, and data annual plan at half price, only $15 per month. All deals are listed below.

Best Buy's massive 60th anniversary sale adds a new round of deals: TVs starting from $110, up to 50% off tech products, $1,000 off appliances, and more

AirPods deals drop further, now up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off, and more

After a summer of steady deals on Apple's latest AirPods lineup, prices have dropped again on nearly every model. The sought-after AirPods Pro 3 are now selling at 25% off, one of the best prices ever; AirPods 4 with ANC has also dropped to its lowest price in months, and AirPods Max 2 dropped further to $120 off this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)

M4 Mac mini's ultra-rare deal appears today at Apple's official refurbished store, $150 off

Update: This deal has sold out, we'll be watching closely for restocks.

While models like the AirPods Pro 3, the new AirTag 2, and M5 MacBook Pro all have solid deals, the latest M4 Mac mini has been very hard to come by. It's been nearly impossible to find at retailers like Amazon and Best Buy, and past deals have been hard to come by. We just spotted an extremely rare opportunity to grab the 16GB/512GB M4 Mac mini with a $150 discount through Apple's official refurbished store.

Apple's official certified refurbished store is now selling the M4 Mac mini with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for $849 with free shipping.

New low: 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro gets massive $500 price cut via Amazon

This week has brought notable $400 discounts on the new M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations, as part of a special one-day Apple event. However, we want to focus on one of the models — this 2TB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is now $500 off on Amazon.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB built-in SSD for $2,699 with free shipping.

This is the $3,199 configuration with the upgraded 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU (instead of the 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU version currently $400 off). Although this model's price was just raised recently, it's still $100 below the previous lower MSRP.

Both options are solid choices depending on the performance you need — now $400 and $500 off respectively; the CPU/GPU upgrade normally costs an extra $200, but with current deals, you're only paying $100 more:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (originally $2,999) 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (originally $3,199) 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

We expect this $500 discount to return to its original price quickly, but we can't confirm whether it will last until Sunday when this week's major sale event ends.

Apple's latest AirTag 2 hits an all-time low on Amazon this week, but here's how to get one for $20

This week's Apple deals are in full swing, with AirPods Pro 3 still at 25% off, and the latest AirPods Max 2 also featuring the best $120 discount yet. Alongside $500 off on multiple M5 Pro MacBook Pro models, some of the more notable deals are also on the latest AirTag 2 trackers, with both the single pack and 4-pack returning to all-time low prices — but you can now grab one for as low as $20.

Amazon has reduced AirTag 2 single pack and 4-pack prices back to the lowest we've seen since their earlier launch this year:

  • AirTag 2 $24 (originally $29)
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (originally $99)

At 4-pack pricing, that's as low as $22.25 per tracker, while the single-pack AirTag 2 returns to its all-time low of $24 from Prime Day.

While the difference isn't massive, it's worth noting that Best Buy's 'excellent' grade open-box single-pack AirTag 2 is also at the lowest price we've seen — you can grab one for just $19.99.

  • AirTag 2 'excellent' open-box $20 (originally new $29) | Best Buy

Although this price is only $4 cheaper than Amazon's new units, I'd personally rather buy new, but it is indeed lower priced. Best Buy also offers the same deal on new units, so if you're already ordering through their ongoing 60th anniversary sale, it's worth checking out their options.

Apple Watch Series 11 anniversary week $100 off, Best Buy open-box from $254

Anker's all-new SmartTrack Find My wallet card (iOS or Android supported) drops to $25 all-time low on Amazon

Anker recently launched its all-new SmartTrack Find My Card for your wallet — the first product to support both Apple's tracking platform and Google's Find Hub — now dropped to a new all-time low on Amazon, $25 with free shipping for Prime members.

Anker's EufyHome official Amazon store is now selling the new SmartTrack Card E40 (iOS or Android supported) for $24.99, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

This product launched on Amazon last month at $35, got a slight $5 price drop by month's end, and now is seeing its first significant discount, hitting a new all-time low on Amazon.

That's nearly a 30% discount, matching prices with some of the better wallet tracker card deals this year.

I'm personally a big fan of Nomad's tracker cards — starting from $35, with the Pro model featuring 16-month rechargeable battery life priced at $45 — but regardless of which you choose, I think everyone should put one in their wallet or cardholder. I never leave home without it.

Anker's latest SmartTrack Card E40 has all the most important features, including wireless charging, compatible with both Apple Find My platform or Google Find Hub. At only 1.7mm thick, with a ring volume of up to 80dB for finding it nearby — of course, it can also be loaded directly into the Find My and Find Hub apps to check its location on the map.

Mint Mobile launches super deal at half price, unlimited talk, text, and data annual plan only $15 per month

Mint Mobile is now running an amazing promotion on unlimited 5G/4G LTE mobile plans. Although this carrier offers solid value most of the year, its unlimited 12-month plan is now only $15 a month — that's half price, totaling $180 for a full year of unlimited talk, text, and data. Even if you're not planning to switch your primary plan right now, this price is low enough to consider as a backup or secondary line for iPad.

While the 17GB and 23GB plans are also discounted, the best value here is the 5G • 4G LTE plan: unlimited / MO 12-month, only $15 per month.

  • Mint Mobile 12-month unlimited plan $15/month (half price)

According to the fine print, you need to prepay $180 for a 12-month plan (equivalent to $15/month), but for those looking to switch to a new carrier at a discount, or wanting to open a secondary line for other devices / as backup, this is a very deep discount.

If your phone supports eSIM, you can 'activate service immediately,' with service available for various Apple, Samsung, and Google devices. You can keep your existing number if needed, and bring your own unlocked phone to use this service.

Please visit the promotion page for more details.

New wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits all-time low on Amazon, nearly 30% off (wired version also discounted)

As part of late-summer deals on Fire tablets, Fire TV, and Blink smart home lineup, Amazon is also selling the latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro at its lowest price ever, with the wired version reduced back to Prime Day's all-time low price — both nearly 30% off MSRP.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (originally $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (originally $250)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Anker's MagSafe chargers this week from $36 with free shipping (multiple color options)
  • Anker 25W Qi2 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger is a top pick, now 35% off (matching all-time low)
  • Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the best-looking MagSafe stands I've seen, grab it for $27 (originally $35)
  • Twelve South all-in-one fabric PowerCord USB-C charger drops to $16.50 (45% off)
  • Anker Nano 100W three-port charger with 5-foot cable, today down to $36
  • Woot's massive PC sale officially launches, gaming desktops, monitors, coolers, and more up to 75% off, deals from $5
  • This compact SSD enclosure with display features power loss protection, today only $29
  • Razer portable 11-in-1 USB-C hub plummets to all-time low $52 (57% off)
  • Twelve South's USB-C wall charger with Find My feature just hit an all-time low on Amazon, under $37
  • Wow! These genuine leather Apple Watch bands are only $6 with Prime free shipping (75% off)

Amazon now has AirPods Max 2 in all five colors at $120 off (one of the best prices ever)

This week's massive 60th anniversary sale brings one of the best prices ever for Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon now offering $120 off MSRP across all five colors.

Amazon is now selling Apple AirPods Max 2 for $429 with free shipping.

Compared to the previous generation at the same $549 MSRP, you're now saving $120, which is the best price we've found on new units from reputable retailers.

Best Buy's Midnight black 'excellent' open-box version drops to $403.99 with free shipping — although lower priced, it may not be low enough to give up the new version.

Apple truly launched a new generation of AirPods Max this year, rather than just changing colors and adding a USB-C port. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, their over-ear option won't be updated in next month's new product announcement, so the $120 discount we're getting this week may be on Apple's latest and greatest over-ear headphones for some time to come.

The only previous sale offering lower prices was this summer's Prime Day, where the price was $30 lower than today's deal price — and stock was quite limited and unstable during the 4-day promotion.

Amazon's top-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models drop $220 today (matching Prime Day deal)

Although Apple's official certified refurbished store is my first choice for iPhone deals, Apple hasn't yet listed the latest iPhone 17 Pro series there, possibly waiting until the 18 series launches next month. Amazon's top-quality Premium Renewed listings have returned to Prime Day pricing, with up to $220 off new MSRP.

Amazon's top-tier Premium Renewed models have been the best option for unlocked iPhone 17 Pro deals to date. Not only do you save hundreds, but you also get a 1-year Amazon Renewed warranty and 'greater than 90% original battery life' — Amazon's non-'premium' refurbished listings only offer a 90-day warranty with different battery life performance.

Now 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models are back online, up to $220 off — the 512GB version is $20 lower than the price we last mentioned:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (originally new $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (originally new $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (originally new $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (originally new $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (originally new $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (originally new $1,299)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple refurbished store feature, you can grab perfectly capable iPhone 16 models from $699 with 1-year Apple warranty, or grab a 1TB 16 Pro Max for $1,269 — $330 less than the equivalent 17 Pro Max, and $130 less than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 less than the 17 series)

More of this week's best Apple deals:

Anker 45W Nano smart display charger still at the low price of $26, but this bundle costs just $4 more and includes a USB-C cable

Take-Two officially files subpoena in federal court to track down GTA VI leaker
